title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataPortability
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataPortability. Which resource of the service offering is concerned by this data portability measure. For example, backup files, stored personal data, infrastructure description file (IaaS), etc.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataPortability'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

resource.description: Property. Resource of the service offering concerned by data portability.

contactInformation.description: Relationship. Allows providing a specific provider contact point for data portability. Links to a ContactInformation entity.

means.description: Property. Means used to transfer the customer's stored data to another provider.

documentations.description: Property. Documentation(s) explaining how data portability can be done.

legalDocument.description: Relationship. Legal document describing the data portability agreement between the Provider and the Customer. Links to a LegalDocument entity.

deletionMethods.description: Property. Methods used to delete the customer's data.

deletionTimeframe.description: Property. Timeframe within which the customer's data will be deleted.

formats.description: Property. Technical formats for Provider support in importation/exportation processes.

pricing.description: Property. Link to the service's pricing page.
